Product Features

  • OVERALL SIZE: Upgrade your room with this stylish sideboard! It measures 140 x 38 x 70 cm and features a black-look chipboard with a marble texture for a long-lasting style.
  • Marble veneer: The marble veneer of the countertop adds a sense of luxury and is an eye-catcher in the living room, hallway or office.
  • Total load capacity: The total load capacity is 45 kg. It is sturdy and durable, and can easily carry everyday items such as books and decorative ornaments.
  • A cabinet is versatile: from displaying collections in the living room to storing small items in the hallway to organizing documents in the office, a cabinet is versatile and can meet the storage needs of multiple rooms.
  • Large Storage Space: Three-layer design, three cabinet doors open six storage compartments, helping you say goodbye to clutter and keep your items in order.
  • Adjustable dividers: The dividers in each cabinet are movable shelves that can be flexibly adjusted depending on the size of the items to make the most of storage space.
  • Presentation: The flat top is great for displaying decorations such as your favorite vases, photos, or small items.
  • Simple Design: Simple and modern design in black and gold, suitable for all types of rooms. Whether it's a living room, hallway or office, it can add accents to the decoration.
  • Practical and beautiful: While you enjoy your coffee time, there are practical storage solutions to keep magazines, documents and the like neatly stored.
  • NOTE: This product is shipped in two packages and may not arrive at the same time, please wait until both packages are received by you to assemble it to ensure a smoother installation!
